                      OPPOSITION OF DEFENDANT KATIE HALL, ESQ.
                           TO PLAINTIFF’S MOTION FOR LEAVE
                    TO SERVE LIMITED DISCOVERY UNDER RULE 26(d)(1)

       Defendant Katie Hall, Esq., by and through undersigned counsel and pursuant to the

Rules and Orders of this Honorable Court, hereby respectfully opposes the pro se Plaintiff’s

“Motion for Leave to Serve Three Limited Interrogatories on NCMEC before the Rule 26(f)

Conference.” [Doc. 15] Defendant Hall adopts and joins in the Opposition [Doc. 33] filed by

Defendant the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children.

                                             Respectfully submitted,
